gate: REH14 batch manifest read 15 to 37 s under load; offline unit checks only, no runtime gate passed

read.before: BEGIN; SET TRANSACTION REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY; cases by id; items (itemSelect) by case; then for each distinct original source of the case, intakeSourceTx: cases by id again and SELECT * FROM sources by (case_id,id) with the whole inspection blob; COMMIT. Statements: 5 + 2S for S originals (S=80: 165). Then each item parsed by IntakeItemSchema in intakeItem and every item parsed again by IntakeManifestSchema.
read.after: BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ, READ ONLY (the existing db transaction mode); cases by id; items (itemSelect, unchanged); one sources read for all S originals with only the inspection keys the authority check reads; COMMIT. Statements: 5 for any S (4 when the case has no original). Each item is parsed by IntakeItemSchema once.
read.dominantCost: Round trips scale with originals: each awaited statement waits for the API event loop, which REH14 loaded with several batches' readers in the same process; 2S serial round trips is where a slow turn multiplies. Second: the whole sources.inspection jsonb (manual profiles, gis, accepted reader results) was detoasted and sent per source although the check reads only *Original receipts and actor. Third: double schema parse of every item's card.

queries.before: S x (Index Scan sources_pkey, id=$2, filter case_id=$1) plus S x (Index Scan cases_pkey); full inspection returned
queries.after: 1 x Index Scan sources_pkey with id = ANY($2::uuid[]), filter case_id=$1; inspection reduced in the server by jsonb_each + jsonb_object_agg over keys LIKE '%Original' or 'actor' (non-object inspection passed as it was)
queries.why: same rows, same snapshot, same order of checks, so the first refusal (404 NOT_FOUND, 403 INTAKE_SOURCE_DENIED, 422 INTAKE_SOURCE_INTEGRITY) is the one it was; S-1 fewer round trips for sources and S fewer for cases

queries.before: 1 + S reads of cases by id in one REPEATABLE READ snapshot
queries.why: the repeated reads saw the same snapshot row; binding is a pure function of caseId and configuration

queries.before: Index Scan usp_intake_case_wave_idx (case_id,wave,item_id), Left Join sources_pkey, LATERAL Limit 1 on usp_streamed_profile_source_idx (case_id,source_id,created_at DESC) gated by a one-time filter, Sort on wave,name,item_id
queries.why: already indexed; the select list stays i.* because existing tests match it and probe_ref (the only unused jsonb) is never written

indexes.missing: none for the manifest's WHERE, JOIN and ORDER BY; no migration added

jobs: the manifest reads no jobs or event tables; no job counts are scanned
contract: response unchanged: caseId and items are the same values IntakeItemSchema produced before; IntakeManifestSchema parse of already-parsed items was a deep-equal copy. openapi --check matches; source pins refreshed for the two producer files
